caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of fabric, possibly linen, arranged with various colorful embroidered motifs and text. The background is a light beige color. At the top, there are two identical embroidered images of two birds facing each other on a perch, in green, orange, and red thread, placed on either side of a central motif of a purple and green deer under a tree with pink flowers. Below these, on the main section, there are two yellow and blue eight-pointed stars, one on each side, flanking a central red heart motif with a smaller blue and pink heart inside and floral or bird-like shapes perched on its top. Below this are two orange, blue, and brown pitchers with green rims, also symmetrically positioned on each side of a central green and orange horse figure. Underneath, there is a horizontal row with red roses, green stems, and two blue birds, alternating with a red zigzag line above it. In the next section, an embroidered inscription in block letters of various colors (red, green, blue, and yellow) reads, "JACOB STAUFFER. THIS TOWEL I MADE FOR SAKE OF THE WHEN THIS YOU SEE REMEM BER ME 1847." At the bottom, another fold of fabric is visible with two motifs: a tree with green leaves and pink trunk on the left, and a symmetrical red and green geometric shape with antler-like extensions on the right. The bottom edge of the fabric is fringed. The composition uses cross-stitch technique for all patterns and text, primarily featuring colors such as red, green, yellow, blue, orange, pink, and purple.
title: Pa. German Show Towel
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
